We’ve spent years creating spaces for kids to make, experiment and get messy at Firefly. Now, it’s the grown-ups’ turn.🤍

Introducing The Creative Pause - a Saturday morning art club for curious adults. Come slow down, make something with your hands, meet new people and just enjoy being creative! 

We’re starting with Mandala Basics - 4 Saturdays of patterns, symmetry, colour and quiet, mindful creating. No art experience needed.

Every Saturday | 10:30 AM–12 PM
Starting 3 October | 4 sessions | ₹3,800 Materials included
📍The Firefly Terrace, Jayanagar

Come alone or bring a friend.
Slow down. Make something. Take a little pause.

Comment “Pause” to join. 🤍
